# std.default

<!-- Generated by `badger doc std` from the checked interfaces (badger 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

The default value of each built-in type, in one place.

A record's fields follow the same convention, so a settings record or
a DTO does not repeat the zero values:

```badger
import std.default

let settings = {
    port: default.int(),
    name: default.string(),
    tags: default.list(),
}
```

## Functions

### `bool`

```badger
fn bool() -> Bool
```

The default of a `Bool` field (false).

### `float`

```badger
fn float() -> Float
```

The default of a `Float` field (0.0).

### `int`

```badger
fn int() -> Int
```

The default of an `Int` field (0).

### `list`

```badger
fn list<T>() -> List<T>
```

The default of a `List<T>` field (empty).

### `map`

```badger
fn map<K, V>() -> Map<K, V> where K: Hash
```

The default of a `Map<K, V>` field (empty).

### `option`

```badger

```

### `string`

```badger

```
